definitions.explanation: The lower part of a river, closer to where it empties into the sea.
The socially or economically disadvantaged class.

examples.japanese: {川|かわ}の{下流|かりゅう}に{流|なが}れた。
{下流|かりゅう}では{川幅|かわはば}が{広|ひろ}がる。
{下流|かりゅう}{域|いき}は{洪水|こうずい}の{被害|ひがい}を{受|う}けやすい。
examples.english: The lower reaches are prone to flood damage.

examples.japanese: {下流|かりゅう}{社会|しゃかい}という{言葉|ことば}が{話題|わだい}になった。
examples.english: The term 'lower-class society' became a topic of discussion.

examples.japanese: {格差|かくさ}が{広|ひろ}がり{下流|かりゅう}に{転落|てんらく}する{人|ひと}が{増|ふ}えた。
examples.english: As inequality widened, more people fell into the lower class.

examples.japanese: {中流|ちゅうりゅう}から{下流|かりゅう}へと{滑|すべ}り{落|お}ちる{不安|ふあん}を{抱|かか}える{人|ひと}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many people feel anxiety about slipping from the middle class to the lower class.

notes:
USAGE: Pairs with {上流|じょうりゅう} (upstream/upper class) and {中流|ちゅうりゅう} (midstream/middle class).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {川|かわ}の{下流|かりゅう}: lower reaches of a river
- {下流|かりゅう}{域|いき}: downstream area
- {下流|かりゅう}{社会|しゃかい}: lower-class society
- {下流|かりゅう}{階級|かいきゅう}: lower class

CULTURE: The book {下流|かりゅう}{社会|しゃかい} (2005) by {三浦|みうら}{展|あつし} popularized the term to describe the growing economic underclass in Japan.
